headline: BIDV rolls out preferential credit package worth VND 50,000 billion for business customers
summary: Vietnam's BIDV is launching a preferential interest rate lending program of up to VND 50,000 billion, applied across its entire system. The aim is to support growth drivers and small and medium-sized enterprises.
why: BIDV is one of Vietnam's largest state-controlled commercial banks, so its lending programs shape credit conditions for businesses and the broader economy.
